description: The workspace's FAQ auto-replies: what each matches, the public reply (and its other wordings) and/or DM it sends, suggest or auto mode, and how many answers went out or wait for a tap. results_30d says what each rule did in the last 30 days: answers and DMs sent, on their way, waiting, skipped, failed, and which keywords matched most. accounts says, per account that takes comment answers, how many answers went without a tap in the last 24 hours, how many wait for the daily cap to roll on, and how many people opted out of DMs.
